source_note: Drive units salvaged from consumer robots, characterised by open measurement (OOMWOO's part-specs, Apache-2.0). Not rated by any maker; torque limits unknown.

families.quote: Measured by @IKsares on one aftermarket Roborock S5 Max-family module (motor CDM GM-RS360-16248, DC 12.0V): R 5.08 ohm, brush drop 1.91 V, no-load 0.13 A at 12 V, 6150-6180 rpm no-load at 12 V, gearbox 65.36:1 by tooth count, wheel 71.5 mm, stall 2.46 A at 14.4 V by (V - V0)/R

derivation.basis: No-load speed and stall torque at 14.4 V are derived from the measured constants: back-EMF (V - V0 - I0 R) over the measured 12 V speed gives Ke = Kt; stall torque is Kt (I_stall - I0) through the gearbox at an ASSUMED 60% efficiency (four stages, not measured). No-load current at 14.4 V is taken as the 12 V figure. One unit, measured cold.
